title: Simpkinson's NASA files auctioned and bought by Ed Wilson

tellings.quote:
NASA files and, um, and then, when he
died and she died, they became
public and were put up for auction,
and Ed Wilson bought them, and that's how
he got them and discovered the lithograph
among them.

plain: NASA files kept by a man named Scott Simkinson are said to have gone public and been sold at auction after he and a woman named Emily Erdle died. A man named Ed Wilson bought them and found a lithograph, a kind of printed picture, among them. A researcher named Kevin Knuth tells this on the show without naming a source, as the story of how Wilson came to have the files.
